The '''Relby-v10 micro grenade launcher''' was a highly destructive blaster/mortar weapon modified from the [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] [[CSPL-12 projectile launcher/Legends|CSPL-12]] [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile launcher]]. It was commonly referred to simply as a '''Mortar Gun'''.

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] was known to carry a Relby-v10.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bossk's weapon was a modified British Schermuly anti-riot gun, with sighting scopes mounted on top.<ref name="SWI 57">{{InsiderCite|57|Set Piece|Set Piece: Imperial Star Destroyer}}</ref>
